source: Pew Research Center. 2016. "One-in-Five U.S. Adults Were Raised in Interfaith Homes."
method: Population is current religious tradition (reltrad). qd1a asks whether an adequate income is very important, somewhat important, or not important for a successful marriage; this reads the 'very important' top box; don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted (this recontact reached only 5,000 of the main 2014 RLS's 35,071 respondents). Weighted by the dataset's own `rweight` variable.
